MEASURED_SCOPE_OF_THAT_SITE.source: diagnostics/pmo_call_site_reach_v1.json, 503 of 5742 archived entries of the completed 3x250 run
MEASURED_SCOPE_OF_THAT_SITE.STRUCTURAL_FACT: All five PRESERVE the heavy-atom count; measured paired dHeavy is exactly 0.000000 with zero variance, and a test pins it. atom_insert and atom_delete -- the two largest families in the per-edit census and both net negative on QED -- do NOT route through this site.
MEASURED_SCOPE_OF_THAT_SITE.consequence: A QED result measured at this site is not a result about the proposal stream. Wiring this site alone cannot address the QED collapse.

INTERFACES.draw_weighting: LearnedSuccessorPrior.order(source, rng, family=..., actions=...) -> permutation; .weights(...) -> normalized positive weights; .probability_of(...) for artifact accounting.
INTERFACES.path_ranking: LearnedSuccessorPrior.path_log_likelihood(states, actions) -> {total_log_likelihood, per_step_log_likelihood, per_step_probability, scored_steps, unjoined_steps, ...}. Rank DIFFERENT-length paths by per_step (total falls monotonically with length); rank SAME-length paths by total. Always report unjoined_steps -- a path with unjoined steps is scored on less evidence.
INTERFACES.settings: floor=0.05 (support floor, caps the spread at 20x so nothing is ever excluded), temperature=1.0, time=0.5.
INTERFACES.cost_counters: .statistics -> model_forwards / candidates_scored / candidates_joined / successor_executions / orders_drawn. Load-independent; wall clock on this machine is contaminated.

PRECEDENT_THAT_IS_NOT_THIS.what_it_is: return_weighted_proposal_nce_v1 -- a 4096-dim linear model over Morgan fingerprints, trained by noise-contrastive estimation on campaign RETURN (return_beta 10.0), consumed by lazy exact rejection sampling at 4.2 attempts per primitive.
PRECEDENT_THAT_IS_NOT_THIS.its_result: best-score NULL; its own README says 'Do not extend this recipe unchanged.'
PRECEDENT_THAT_IS_NOT_THIS.why_it_does_not_bear_on_this_work: It is TASK-TRAINED on the campaign's own oracle returns, so it carries objective information and is exactly not a task-independent chemistry prior. Its null is evidence that a RETURN-weighted proposal did not help, which is consistent with the diagnosis that the missing thing is chemistry. Different object, different mechanism (rejection sampling vs floored re-ranking).
